name: Anedot
description: Anedot is a fundraising and payment platform for nonprofits, churches, ministries, political campaigns and committees. Organizations use Action Pages to collect donations, recurring commitments, supporter leads and other form submissions, then relay that activity to connected systems.
agentUseSummary: Anedot cannot currently be installed as a Relay agent connector because it publishes no customer-callable account API, delegated OAuth contract, remote MCP service or distributable general API-token contract. Its supported integration surface is dashboard-configured outbound webhooks containing donor and payment-event data, which Relay will not ingest until an approved callback, retention, deletion and privacy boundary exists.

webhookRequirements.event: submission, donation and commitment lifecycle events
webhookRequirements.signature: Anedot documents a SHA-256 HMAC hex digest in X-Request-Signature using the webhook secret token and exact request body. Relay does not expose this route until an approved event-retention, deletion, tenant-binding and sensitive-field contract is implemented.

blocked.label: Connect an Anedot account
blocked.description: Anedot does not publish a supported OAuth, customer API-key, remote MCP or other customer-callable account contract for Relay.

blocked.label: Call Anedot account APIs
blocked.description: Relay will not reverse engineer private endpoints or repurpose the API token Anedot documents only inside its Zapier integration.

blocked.label: Ingest Anedot donor and payment webhooks
blocked.description: Relay does not accept or persist Anedot's sensitive webhook payloads without an approved HMAC secret lifecycle, tenant binding, event schema, retention, deletion, replay and privacy contract.

blocked.label: Automate the private Anedot application
blocked.description: Relay does not collect Anedot passwords, impersonate account holders, automate its private dashboard or configure integrations through browser automation.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled until Anedot publishes a supported customer-callable interface or Relay approves an end-to-end webhook ingestion and data-governance contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented customer-callable Anedot API or remote MCP tools are available; sensitive outbound webhooks are not an approved OpenClaw runtime source.
No documented customer-callable Anedot API or remote MCP tools are available; sensitive outbound webhooks are not an approved Hermes runtime source.

providerSetup.blocker: Anedot's current public materials document dashboard-managed third-party relays and signed outbound webhooks, but no general customer-callable API with endpoints, authorization, permissions, limits and lifecycle suitable for Relay agents. Webhook payloads can include donor identity, address, employment, IP, donation, commitment and payment-card metadata.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Anedot credentials or show Connect. Reconsider only if Anedot publishes a supported customer API/MCP contract or Relay approves a provider-reviewed webhook receiver with exact raw-body HMAC verification, tenant/secret lifecycle, schemas, replay defense, minimization, encryption, retention, deletion and agent-query boundaries.

evidence.supports: Anedot documents dashboard-configured HTTPS outbound webhooks for submission, donation and commitment events, signed with a SHA-256 HMAC in X-Request-Signature; payload mappings include extensive donor, employment, IP, donation, commitment and payment metadata.

Anedot documents an API token only inside its first-party Zapier connection, authenticated with the account email and then scoped by Account UID and optional Action Page; it publishes no reusable endpoint or general third-party token contract.
Anedot's official integration directory lists product-managed CRM, marketing, political, financial, Zapier and Webhook relays rather than a public customer account API.

Anedot emphasizes privacy, encryption and PCI safeguards for donor and payment data, reinforcing that Relay must not ingest broad webhook payloads without an explicit reviewed data-governance boundary.
